quality.review_scope: All eight supplied main pages read and visually inspected with independent source, canonical, molecular, apparatus and reader audits. Nine Ag A–I experiments, separate Ir/Pt conditions, typical framework, common workup, unassigned microscopy/optical cohorts, prior comparisons and author models retain their distinct scope. No matched SI verified; no invented per-run masses, Pt precursor correction or atomic coordinates.
missing_fields: SI not located or verified; absence is not established.
No measured atomic coordinates, refined unit cell, experimental CIF, XRD or SAED supplied.
Unless explicitly named, source figures lack an assigned Table 1 experiment or physical batch identity.
conflicts: The body summarizes the smallest Ag mean diameter as 25 Å; Table 1 B and the conclusion give 26 Å. Preserve row B at its tabulated value.
The body summarizes thiol/precursor ratios as 6–15; Table 1 includes 5.7 and 5.8. Row-specific values take priority for corresponding recipes.

The global ±47% distribution-width summary does not replace the 38–57% row-specific relative standard deviations. Tabulated percentage widths are retained as printed rather than recomputed from rounded diameters.
Figure 4 caption names experiments D–G (four cases), but its graphic has five points including two at 70 °C. The additional point is unassigned; no silent H join.
The Hamaker discussion calls CO2 supercritical at 25 °C, while the Introduction gives a 31 °C critical temperature. Preserve temperature and phase-label conflict; do not transfer 25 °C to synthesis.
The ψ2 integral uses the printed η/dv notation without a fully specified normalization transformation; no numerical reimplementation is asserted.
